about.title: About
about.heading: Building scalable software solutions from idea to production.
body: I am a Software Engineer focused on designing and developing modern digital platforms, combining frontend architecture, backend services, cloud infrastructure and automation to solve real business problems.

My work is driven by clean architecture, performance, maintainability and user experience. I also explore AI-powered workflows and agentic tools as a way to accelerate development and create smarter solutions when they add real value.

contact.title: Collaboration
contact.heading: Have a software idea or technical challenge?
contact.description: Open to collaborating on web platforms, frontend architecture, backend services, cloud integrations, automation workflows and AI-enhanced software solutions.
